item.title: The case for Rose in Street Fighter 6 goes through K-Pop Demon Hunters and following up on a key storyline from prior game
item.description: <p>Rose from the Street Fighter 5 character select screen is featured on both sides of the image of this story, the middle is Rumi from Netflix's K-Pop Demon Hunters. K-Pop Demon Hunters has over 236 million views and is the most watched film on Netflix, the world's biggest streaming company.</p> <p>You can see that the two bear a striking resemblance to one another, Rose and Rumi, with their hair color, similar face and eye shape, and noses and mouths.</p>

item.title: Street Fighter 6 server maintenance coming tonight for new balance and feature update
item.description: <p>It's been around three months since Street Fighter 6 received a sizable update, but there's finally a new one about to drop.</p> <p>Capcom has announced that Street Fighter 6 will be undergoing server maintenance tonight, December 15, for the <a href="https://www.eventhubs.com/news/2025/dec/14/balance-changes-street-fighter-6/">new balance and feature update, which they've already released the patch notes for</a>.</p>

item.title: Tekken 8 Version 2.08.01 patch notes released, server maintenance underway
item.description: <p>Tekken 8 just released <a href="https://www.eventhubs.com/news/2025/dec/01/miary-tekken-starter-guide/">Miary Zo as the final Season 2 character</a> earlier this month, but they're already making some more changes to the game.</p> <p>Bandai Namco has now released the Version 2.08.01 patch notes for Tekken 8 with server maintenance for the new update going on now.</p>
